rules.title: Accident & Assassination
rules.text:
Accident & Assassination
Accident / escape from accident:
If the sub lord of the Ascendant, 8th or 12th cusp be the significator of 8 or 12, the native is likely to meet with an accident.
If the sub lord of the Ascendant, 8th or 12th cusp be the significator of 8 or 7 or 2, the native is likely to meet with a fatal accident; if significator of 1 or 5 or 11, one will be safe from accidents.
If the sub lord of the 8th or 12th cusp be the significator of 1-5-11 the native will overcome danger, during the joint period of 1-5-11.
Accidents and unnatural deaths are caused during the joint period of the significators of 8-12, Badhaka and Maraka.

Assassinations (हत्या):
If 8th or 12th sub lord signifies 8-12-Badhaka-Maraka, one can get assassinated in the joint period of 8-12-Badhaka-Maraka.
If 8th or 12th sub lord signifies 8-12-Badhaka-Maraka, the native is likely to meet with a fatal assassination during joint period of 8-12-Maraka and Badhaka. If it be a significator of 1-5-11, one will be safe from assassination.

rules.title: Admission in Desired College
rules.text:
Admission in Desired College
If the cuspal sub lord of the 4th be the significator of 4-11, admission in desired college is promised during the joint period of 4-11.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 4-11, admission in desired college is promised during the joint period of 4-11.

rules.title: Acting in Cinema
rules.text:
Acting in Cinema
If the cuspal sub lord of the 5th cusp be the significator of 5th (art) - 6th (efficiency in work) - 10th (business/job/reputation), one can get success in acting.
If the significators of 6th and 10th be connected with 5th, then during their joint period, one gets success as a cinema actor.

rules.title: Arrest & Legal Proceedings
rules.text:
Arrest & Legal Proceedings
Arrest a person:
If 6th sub lord (Police) signifies 1 (Self effort) and 11 (Success), Police will be able to arrest runaway person during the joint period of 1-11.
If 11th sub lord (Court order) signifies 6 (Victory on enemy) - 11 (Success), one can get arrested by police on court order during the joint period of 6-11.
If 7th sub lord signifies 5 (Gain to opponent) - 10 (4th from 7th come back home) - 6 (12th from 7th Lost reputation), arrest on court order during joint period of 5-6-10.

rules.title: Astrology as a Profession
rules.text:
Astrology as a Profession
If sub-lord of Ascendant be the significator of 9-12, one will get mastery in astrology. Jupiter is natural ruler of 9 and 12. Moon gives thoroughness. Saturn gives deep thinking. If sub lord (esp. Saturn) signifies 9-12 then one gets mastery.
If sub-lord of 10th be the significator of 2-9-10-11, one will be a successful astrologer during the joint period of 2-9-10-11.

rules.title: BUSINESS & PROFESSION
rules.text:
BUSINESS & PROFESSION
PROFESSION INDICATED BY PLANETS
046 Professional Qualities indicated by the Planets:
 Sun indicates independent spirit and working within social
and government laws;
 Moon indicates emotional involvement for social purpose;
 Mars indicates analytical ability, argumentative disposition,
independent outlook and logical analysis;
 Mercury indicates quick speech, calculation and grasp of
arguments;
 Jupiter indicates strong knowledge and acumen to judge;
 Venus indicates managing capability without having
emotional involvement;
 Saturn indicates rendering justice, working hard and being
cool head;
 Rahu indicates working on software and big machines; and
 Kethu indicates perfectness and calculative ability.
DOING A BUSINESS
047 Rule for business or Service:
 If 10th Cuspal Sub Lord is deposited in constellation of a planet
which signifies 6th house, then it indicates that the native will
work in service sector.
 If 10th Cuspal Sub Lord is deposited in constellation of a planet
which signifies 7th house, then it indicates that the native will
carry his own business or profession.
 If 10th Cuspal Sub Lord is deposited in constellation of a planet
which signifies both 6th as well as 7th house, then it indicates that
the native will be working in service sector for some time and then
he will be switching over to his own business or profession.

rules.title: Business Future
rules.text:
Business Future
If the cuspal sub lord of the 10 (Independent business) be the significator of 2 (Money/wealth) - 7 (business with others) - 10 (Business) an independent business or profession is promised during the joint period of 2-7-10.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th be the significator of 2-10-11, gain in business is promised during the joint period of 2-10-11.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th be the significator of 7-11, partnership is promised during the joint period of 7-11.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th be the significator of 8-12, break-up in partnership is indicated during the joint period of 8-12.

rules.title: Change in Job
rules.text:
Change in Job / Change in place of Job
If the cuspal sub lord of 3 (journey; 3rd is 12th from 4th) or 12 (Life in completely unfamiliar atmosphere) be the significator of 3-12 and connected with 10, transfer from present place to another is promised.
If the sub lord of the 10th cusp be the significator of 3-12, the transfer may happen in service from one place to another.
The transfer takes place during the joint period of the significators of 3-10-12.

rules.title: Change of House
rules.text:
Change of House
If 9th (house you plan to move to) sub lord signifies 4 (House) - 11 (Gain) - 12 (Expenses), one can succeed to get new house.

rules.title: Change of Residence
rules.text:
Change of Residence
If the cuspal sub lord of the 4th be the significator of 3-12, one will be able to change residence during the joint period of 3-12.

rules.title: Buying a Car (Old／New)
rules.text:
Buying a Car (Old/New)
Buying an old car:
If the cuspal sub lord of the 4th (Car) be the significator of 4 (Car) - 11 (Success/Fulfillment of desire) - 12 (Investment) one will have his own vehicle during the joint period of 4-11-12.
Note: For old car, check 10th (Old things). Benefit can be judged by 11th sub lord as well.

Buying a car (new):
If the cuspal sub lord of the 4th (Car) be the significator of 4 - 11 - 12, purchase is promised during joint period of 4-11-12.

rules.title: Cheating
rules.text:
Cheating
If the cuspal sub lord of the 12th be the significator of 5 (Gain to opponent) - 8 (Unfair thing) - 12 (misfortune), there is a chance that one can be cheated. Cheating will happen during the joint period of 8-12.

rules.title: Child Birth
rules.text:
Child Birth
If the sub lord of the 5th cusp (Female) or the 11th cusp (Male) is the significator of 2 (Increase in family) - 5 (Conception, child) - 11 (Desire), child birth is promised during joint period of 2-5-11.
If it is the significator of 1-4-10 (being 12th from 2-5-11), child birth is not promised.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 5th house occupies fruitful sign Cancer, Scorpio or Pisces and is the significator of 2-5-11, the woman concerned is pregnant.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 5th house occupies barren sign Aries, Gemini, Leo or Virgo and is in the star of the planet in the barren sign, then the woman concerned is not pregnant.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 5th house occupies the star of the planet in dual sign Gemini, Sagittarius, Pisces or Mercury, the woman delivers twins or more than one child.

rules.title: CHILDREN AND PROGENY PROGENY RULES
rules.text:
CHILDREN AND PROGENY PROGENY RULES
040 Which Houses are relevant for Child Birth?
 2nd house indicates addition of a member to family.
 5th house is the primary house of child birth.
 8th house indicates surgical implications in child birth.
 11th house indicates fulfillment of desire.
 12th house indicates hospitalization, expenditures and
misfortunes related to child birth.
041 Which Planets are relevant for Child Birth?
 Jupiter is the Chief Karaka for child.
 Mars or Sun connection indicates surgical aid.
 Kethu connection indicates abortion or miscarriage.
 Moon connection indicates emotional instability and depression.
 Saturn connection indicates delay in child birth or lapses unnoticed by doctors.
042 Which Houses represents child in a horoscope?
 5th house indicates first child;
 7th house indicates second child;
 9th house indicates third child; and
 11th house indicates fourth child and so on.
043 Rule for determining whether Child Birth is Promised or Not
 First Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be in direct motion and not
in retrograde motion.
 Second Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in the
constellation of a planet which should be in direct motion.
 Third Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 2nd, 5th or 11th
house.
Note:
x The Horary number for child should preferably be obtained from
the female side, instead of male as the child is conceived by
females only.A Compendium on KP Astrology
17
x In the horary chart, 5th house indicates capability of female to
conceive whereas 11th house indicates capability of the male to
generate sperm.
x Regarding fertility: Please note that if both the houses (i.e., 5th and
11th house) are favourable, then only both are considered fertile
to give birth to a child.
Remedy: If any one of them is infertile, then remedy is to be provided to
both the couple so that the couple may give birth to a child by the
blessing of Lord Narayana. I will be covering the detail of remedy in my
next book.
045 How to determine the Auspicious time for conceiving for
those who have not been able to conceive?
This situation is applicable for those women who have not been able
to conceive a child since long. These women should only conceive
when the following conditions are satisfied:
 Moon should be transiting in the constellation and sub of a planet
which signifies 2nd, 5th and 11th house; without having
signification to 1st, 4th and 10th house.
 The Sub Lord of Moon should be transited by an Ascendant whose
Lord which signifies 2nd, 5th and 11th house.
 Further, the current Dasha and Bhukti should also signify 2nd, 5th
and 11th house; without having signification to 1st, 4th and 10th
house.

rules.title: Coalition ／ Alliance
rules.text:
Coalition / Alliance (and Breaking)
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th (Coalition) be the significator of 4 (support/supporter) - 7 (Alliance) - 11, possibility of coalition/alliance between political party/company during joint period of 4-7-11.
Breaking of Coalition/Alliance: If 11th cuspal sub lord be the significator of 12 (unfortunate circumstances) - 8 (Breaking up) - 1 (Interruption), breaking is possible during 1-8-12.

rules.title: Commission Business
rules.text:
Commission Business
If the cuspal sub lord of 3rd (Commission) be the significator of 2-6-11, the querent gets benefited from commission work during the joint period of the significators of 2-6-11.

rules.title: Constructing Religious Building
rules.text:
Constructing Religious Building
If the cuspal sub lord of the 10th be the significator of 10 (Construction) - 9 (Religious Place) - 12 (Investment), constructing a religious building is promised during the joint period of 10-9-12.

rules.title: Contract Job
rules.text:
Contract Job
If the cuspal sub lord of 3rd (contract) be the significator of 2-6-10-11, one gets benefitted from contract work during the joint period of the significators of 2-6-10-11.

rules.title: Criminal Proceedings
rules.text:
Criminal Proceedings (आपराधिक कार्यवाही)
If the sub lord of the 10th cusp (status) be the significator of 7 (court proceedings) - 8 (infamy) - 12 (crimes), the native will be involved in court proceedings relating to crimes, be ill-reputed and punished during the joint period of 7-8-12.
If the sub lord of the 12th cusp (jail) be the significator of 3 (away from home), 8 (misfortune) or 12 (restrictions), one has to court jail during the joint period of 3-8-12.

rules.title: Dancing Career
rules.text:
Dancing Career
Dancing comes under 5th cusp. If 5th cusp sublord signifies 5 (Creative ability/Capability) - 10 (Accomplishment/Achievement/Aura of authority) - 11 (Special consideration/Desire), one can achieve a good position in dancing.

rules.title: Cure
rules.text:
Cure (1,5,11)
If the sublord of the 6th or 8th or 12th or 11th cusp be the significator of 1-5-11 disease is cured, or the native is saved from any danger.
During the joint period of the significators of 1-5-11, disease is cured or the native is saved from any danger.
Astrologers need to select from sublord of Ascendant or 6th or 8th or 12th as per their experience. It is advisable that first examine all the cusp sub lords and then come to any conclusion.
If the sub lord of the Ascendant cusp be the significator of 1-5-11, the native may recover after accident or escape from accident during the sub period of this cuspal sublord of 1-5-11. (In Char lagna consider 9th instead of 11).
During the joint period of the significator of 2-4-11 discharge from hospital.

rules.title: DEBAUCHERY AND INCEST
rules.text:
DEBAUCHERY AND INCEST
015 Rule for judging debauchery/incest:
 First Step: All 1st Cusp Co-Rulers (Sign Lord, Constellation Lord
and Sub Lord) shall be connected fully to either Saturn or Mars
or Venus.
 Second Step: All 5th Cusp Co-Rulers (Sign Lord, Constellation Lord
and Sub Lord) shall be connected fully to either Saturn or Mars
or Venus.
 Third Step: All 11th Cusp Co-Rulers (Sign Lord, Constellation Lord
and Sub Lord) shall be connected fully to either Saturn or Mars
or Venus.
Note: For the benefit of readers, it is concluded that if all the co rulers
of 1st house, 5th house and 11th house are connected to Saturn or Mars
or Venus; then the person will be debauch, even to the extent of
committing incest (having sexual pleasure prior to legal marriage).
016 Rule for judging Loss of reputation due to Incest:
5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in constellation of a planet
which signifies 10th house and 12th house.
017 Rule for judging Loss of Property due to Incest:
5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in constellation of a planet
which signifies 4th house and 12th house.
018 Rule for judging Loss of Cash or Bank balances due to
Incest:
5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in constellation of a planet
which signifies 2nd house and 12th house.

rules.title: Disease
rules.text:
Disease (6th)
If the sub lord of the 6th cusp be the significator of 6-8-12 and connected with 1, the native may suffer from disease during the sub period of this cuspal sub lord of 6.
If the sub lord of the 8th or 12th cusp be the significator of 6-8-12 then native suffers from the disease and permanent defect.
During the joint period of the significators of 1-5-11 disease is cured, during the joint period of the significator of 2-11 relieved from hospital.

rules.title: Desired Job ／ Promotion
rules.text:
Desired Job / Promotion
Desired job:
If the cuspal sub lord of the 6th or 10th be the significator of 2-6-10, service or earning is promised during 2-6-10. If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 2-6-10-11, the querent gets a job of expectation during 2-6-10.
Promotion:
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 2-6-10-11, promotion in service is promised during 2-6-10-11.

rules.title: DIVORCE AND REUNION
rules.text:
DIVORCE AND REUNION
022 Which Houses are to be considered for divorce?
 6th house significators brings separation due to partner walking
out or deserting the relationship;
 8th house significators do not threaten separation, but indicates
difficulties in living together; and
 12th house significators indicates separation due to disharmony,
quarrel and misunderstanding with the partner.
 Note: 12th house also provides negative stimulation to the
native/querent to seek separation and live single.Basic Rules & Applied Horoscopes
10
023 Rule for divorce/separation from spouse:
 First Step:
x If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies 1st, 6th and 12th house along with
11th house, then marriage will take place but will end in divorce;
x OR If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is connected to 6th, 8th and 12th house,
then though marriage is promised, there will be separation
between the partners;
 Alternative Step: Promise of Second Marriage in Chart also denotes
end of first marriage. This can be checked from 2nd Cuspal Sub
Lord, i.e., 2nd Cuspal Sub Lord should be connected to the 7th
House.
 Timing of Event: The timing of event of divorce/ separation will be
during the conjoined period of joint significators of 1st, 6th, 10th
and 12th house as agreeing with the Ruling Planets at the date,
time and place of judgement.
024 Reasons for Divorce or breaking of Marriage:
Note the 6th Cuspal Sub Lord and observe in which house it is
positioned.
 If it is positioned in 1st house, then personal concerns will be the
main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 2nd house, then financial security or family
concerns will be the main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 3rd house, then agreement or contract will be
the main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 4th house, then mother or property will be the
main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 5th house, then children or colleagues will be
the main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 6th house, then health problems will be the
main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 7th house, then ex-partner or business deals
will be the main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 8th house, then debts, legal issues or dowry
will be the main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 9th house, then father, stranger, internet
friends or higher education will be the main reason for
divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 10th house, then job or status in society will
be the main reason for divorce/separation;
 If it is positioned in 11th house, then colleagues or known friends
will be the main reason for divorce/separation; and 
  If it is positioned in 12th house, then foreigners or unknown people
will be the main reason for divorce/separation.
025 Rule for checking who will initiate divorce:
 Rule for initiation by the Querent: - If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies
12th house, then the querent will initiate for divorce.
 Rule for initiation by the Partner: If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies
6th house, then the partner will initiate the petition for divorce.
026 Rule for reunion with Spouse:
 First Step: 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 2nd house and 7th
house.
 Second Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in the
constellation of a planet which signifies 2nd, 7th or 11th house;
without signifying 1st, 6th and 10th house.
 Timing of Event: The reunion with spouse will fructify during the
conjoined period of significators of 2nd, 7th and 11th house.

rules.title: Election Ticket
rules.text:
Election Ticket
One can be selected as a candidate for election if 3rd (view of people) sub lord signifies 6 (victory)-10 (One’s political position)-11 (gain).
But if 9th (opposite view of people) sub lord signifies 12 (victory of opponent)-4 (Opponent’s political position)-5 (gain of opponent), the opponent will be selected as a candidate.

rules.title: Education & Examination
rules.text:
Education & Examination
Education:
If the sub lord of the 4th cusp be the significator of 4 (education, preparations for examinations, academic qualifications) - 9 (deep study and higher education) - 11 (success, fulfillment), the native will get academic qualifications during the joint period of 4-9-11.
Education will either be completed or postponed during the joint period of the significators of 3-8-10 (being 12th from 4-9-11 respectively).

Success in examination:
If the sub lord of the 4th cusp is the significator of 4 (examinations) - 9 (higher studies) - 11 (Success), success in examination is promised, when during the days of examination the joint period of 4-9-11 is active.

rules.title: Election Timing & Outcome
rules.text:
Election — Timing & Outcome
Timing:
If 3rd (Election, view of people) sub lord signifies 3 (Election) - 9 (Opposite view) - 11 (Fulfillment of desire), election will be held during the joint period of 3-9-11.

Outcome:
If Ascendant or 10th sub lord (Tendency of people of country) signifies 6 (Military dictatorship) - 11 (Gain), power comes to Military/dictator.
If Ascendant or 10th sub lord signifies 4 (Democracies, democratic government and movements) - 11 (Gain), power comes to Democratic Government.
If Ascendant or 10th sub lord signifies 9 (Religious leader) - 11 (Gain), power comes to Religious leaders.

rules.title: Elections
rules.text:
Elections
One can be selected as a candidate for election, if Ascendant (Tendency of people of country) sub-lord signifies 6 (victory)-10 (One’s political position)-11 (gain).
For the opponent candidate, Ascendant (tendency of people of country) sub-lord should signify 12 (victory of opponent)-4 (Opponent’s political position)-5 (gain of opponent).

rules.title: EXTRA MARITAL AFFAIRS ,ILLEGAL RELATION
rules.text:
EXTRA MARITAL AFFAIRS/ ILLEGAL RELATION
020 Rule for Extra Marital Relation/Illegal Relation/
Licentiousness:
 First Step: If 2nd Cuspal Sub Lord is connected with 11th house
and/or 5th house; with no connection to 7th house, then extra
marital affair is indicated.
 Alternative Step: Sun positioned in 7th house is not favourable for
married life, except in its own sign Leo as, it indicates illegal
relation with more than one partner.
 Timing of Event: The timing of the event of extra marital affairs will
be during the conjoined period of joint significators of 2nd, 5th and
11th house.
021 Rule for illegal husband after marriage and children:
 First Step:
x 2nd Cuspal Sub Lord should be positioned in a dual sign (Gemini,
Virgo, Sagittarius or Pisces) OR
x 2nd Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in the constellation of a
planet positioned in dual sign (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius or
Pisces).
 Second Step: 2nd Cuspal Sub Lord should be the significator of
12th, 3rd, 4th and 5th house.

rules.title: End of Dictator
rules.text:
End of Dictator / Military Ruler
If 8th Sublord (Secret work of enemy/opposition) signifies 5 (12th from 6 — Dictator), 9 (12th from 10 — those in power), 12 (loss), ruler faces trouble and end of his govt. or rule.
If 10th (Ruler) signifies 2 (Maraka) - 7 (Maraka) - 12 (Moksha) and Badhaka, rule will end with death (2-7-12 from 10th).

rules.title: Financial Help from Partner
rules.text:
Financial Help from Partner
If the sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 2-6-11, native gets loan/financial help during joint period of 2-6-11. Partner is 7th; partner’s money is 8th, thus check 8th sub lord also.

rules.title: Gain by Advertisement
rules.text:
Gain by Advertisement
If the sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 2-6-11, native gets financial gain during joint period of 2-6-11.

rules.title: Financial Position
rules.text:
Financial Position (2nd cusp)
If 2nd cusp sub lord signifies 2-6-11, then one can get good financial earning, during the joint period of 2-6-11.

rules.title: Gain from Machine Purchase
rules.text:
Gain from Machine Purchase
Any movable things are considered under 2nd house. 7th indicates opponent; 6th indicates purchase of movable things (12th from 7th means opponents sell movable things) and 4th indicates place of delivery.
If 11th cusp sub lord signifies 2-6-11, then one can gain from movable things during the joint period of 2-6-11.

rules.title: Gender of Child
rules.text:
Gender of Child
Sun, Mars, Jupiter are male planets; Moon, Venus, and Rahu are female; Mercury and Ketu are neuter. Odd signs (1-3-5-7-9-11) indicate male and even signs (2-4-6-8-10-12) indicate female.
5th cusp sign-star-sub lord indicates gender of child. (Prediction is difficult and must be judged holistically.)

rules.title: Getting Donation or Dues
rules.text:
Getting Donation or Dues
Donation:
If 8th sub lord be the significator of 2-6-11, during the joint period of 2-6-11 getting donation is promised.

Dues:
If 8th sub lord be the significator of 2-6-11 during the joint period of 2-6-11, getting due amount is promised.

rules.title: Getting Green Card ／ PR ／ Passport
rules.text:
Getting Green Card / PR / Passport
If 10th (matter depending with others) cusp sub lord signifies 5 (one’s self interest) - 9 (Legal action/success in venture/making something legal/passport) - 11 (one’s reputation as a winner), then in the DBA of 5-9-11, success is assured.

rules.title: Getting Loan
rules.text:
Getting Loan
If the cuspal sub lord of the 6th be the significator of 2-6-10-11, borrowing from bank is promised during the joint period of 2-6-10-11.

rules.title: Going Abroad for Higher Studies
rules.text:
Going Abroad for Higher Studies
If the cuspal sub lord of the 5th (since 9th is higher study and 9th from 9th is 5th) be the significator of 9-12, going abroad for higher study is promised during the joint period of 3-9-12.

rules.title: Getting Tenant
rules.text:
Getting Tenant (Vacant tenant)
Neighbour is 3rd. Tenant is 6th, thus neighbour of tenant is 8th (6th from 3rd).
If the cuspal sub lord of the 8th be the significator of 10 (3rd from 8th, loss of home), 7 (12th from 8th, loss to tenant) or 1 (11th from 3rd, gain to neighbour) vacating the house is promised during the joint period of 10-7-1.

rules.title: Government Job
rules.text:
Government Job
If the cuspal sub lord of the 10th (Government Job) be the significator of 2-6-10 and connected with 10, service in Government sector is promised during the joint period of 2-6-10.

rules.title: Health
rules.text:
Health (1st)
If the sub lord of the Ascendant, be in the star of the occupant of the house 1 or 11, health is normal.
If the sub lord of the Ascendant, be the significator of the house 6 (sickness) or 8 (danger to life) or 12 (hospitalization), it is not good for health.
The native may suffer from sickness or disease during the joint period of the significators of 1 and 6, or 1 and 8, or 1 and 12.

rules.title: Imprisonment ／ Bail
rules.text:
Imprisonment / Bail
Imprisonment:
If the cuspal sub lord of the 12th be the significator of 3 (away from home) - 8 (misfortune) - 12 (restrictions), and connected with Mars or Saturn or Rahu or Ketu, one has to face jail during the joint period of 3-8-12.

Bail:
One can get bail if 12th (any kind of confinement) signifies 2 (Freedom) - 4 (change of environment, Home) - 11 (Fulfillment of desire) during the joint period of 2-4-11.

rules.title: Home Confinement
rules.text:
Home Confinement
One can free from house confinement if 2nd (Freedom) signifies 2 (Freedom)-4 (Change of environment, Home)-11 (Fulfill of desire), during the joint period of 2-4-11.
One can free from house confinement if 12th (any kind of Confinement) signifies 2 (Freedom)-4 (Change of environment, Home)-11 (Fulfill of desire), during the joint period of 2-4-11.

rules.title: Independent Business
rules.text:
Independent Business
If the cuspal sub lord of the 10th (Independent business) be the significator of 2 (Money/wealth) - 7 (Business with others) - 10 (Business), an independent business or profession is promised during the joint period of 2-7-10.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th be the significator of 2-10-11, gain in business is promised during the joint period of 2-10-11.

rules.title: Inheritance Property
rules.text:
Inheritance Property
If the sub lord of the 9th cusp be the significator of 2-11, inheritance property is assured during the joint period of 2-11.

rules.title: Interview for Higher Studies
rules.text:
Interview for Higher Studies
3rd indicates interview/meeting; 7th indicates person we meet; from 7th, 3rd is 9th. For interview consider 3rd & 9th; for fulfillment, consider 11th.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 3 - 9 - 11, a meeting is possible.
Meeting is for higher study, so check 9th cusp sub lord. If 9th cuspal sub lord be significator of 4-9-11 then meeting for admission is successful during 4-9-11.

rules.title: Interview for Job
rules.text:
Interview for Job
3rd indicates interview/meeting; 7th indicates person we meet; from 7th, 3rd is 9th — so meeting with other person is 9th cusp. For interview consider 3rd and 9th cusps. For fulfillment, consider 11th cusp.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 3 (Meeting, Interview) - 9 (meeting with person) - 11 (Gain, Success, fulfillment), a meeting is possible.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 3rd or 9th be the significator of 2-6-10-11 then meeting for job is successful during the joint period of the significators of 2-6-10-11.

Investment in Property

rules.title: Job Change & Promotion
rules.text:
Job Change & Promotion

For job/business we check 2-6-10. 12th from these (1-5-9) are negative for 2-6-10. For change consider 1-5-9-12. If sub lord of 10th or 6th be significator of 1-5-9-12, change of job during 1-5-9; service promised when significator of 2-6-10 is active.
Promotion:
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 2-6-10-11, promotion in service is promised during the joint period of 2-6-10-11.

Job in India or Abroad
If the cuspal sub lord of the 2nd (9th from 6th) be the significator of 9 (abroad/ long journey) or 12 (Stay in abroad) and also signifies 2-6-10, the foreign travel for job is promised during the joint period of the significator of 3-9-12.

rules.title: JUDGING PROFESSION
rules.text:
JUDGING PROFESSION
054 Rules for judging the profession of a native or querent
 Note the 10th house sign lord, star lord and sub lord.
 Note the planets occupying 10th house.
 Note the planets conjoined with 10th house.
 All the planets together shall be churned for making fruitful
prediction.
For Example:
If 10th House sign lord, star lord and sub lord planets are Sun, Mars
and Mercury, then we can state that the native/querent may have the
following professions:
x Mars represents surgical, Mercury gives quick understanding and
grasp of knowledge and Sun represents healing, doctor, etc.
Hence, the profession may be Doctor or Surgeon.
x Similarly, Mars and Mercury represent Mechanical Engineer and
Sun for government service. Hence, the profession may be
mechanical engineer in government organizations.
x Or Mars represents industrial workers, Mercury represents
accounts, audit, finance and Sun represents government service.
Hence, the native may be handling finance jobs at government
industries relating to industrial workers.

LEGAL PROFESSION
055 Rule for Legal Profession:
 First Step: 10th Cuspal Sub Lord is Mercury or Jupiter or Mars or
Sun or Saturn.
 Second Step: AND 10th Cuspal Sub Lord should be connected
with Libra, Aquarius and Sagittarius.

056 Rule for becoming a Judge
 First Step: 10th Cuspal Sub Lord is Mercury or Jupiter or Mars or
Sun or Saturn.
 Second Step: AND 10th Cuspal Sub Lord should be connected
with Libra, Aquarius and Sagittarius.
 Third Step: AND Saturn should be well connected with 10th
Cuspal Sub Lord and Libra, Aquarius and Sagittarius.

ASTROLOGY PROFESSION
057 Rule for knowing Well versed/ Genius/ Popular native in
astrology
 First Step: 9th Cuspal Sub Lord is either Mercury or Jupiter
 Second Step: AND 9th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 10th house,
2nd house, 5th house, 9th house or 11th house.
058 Rule for conducting research in astrology
 First Step: 9th Cuspal Sub Lord is either Mercury or Jupiter
 Second Step: AND 9th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 10th house,
2nd house, 5th house, 9th house or 11th house.Basic Rules & Applied Horoscopes
22
 Third Step: AND 9th Cuspal Sub Lord should be connected to 12th
house.

059 Rule for knowing a Person who pretends to know everything
in astrology and his predictions will be a bundle of lies
 First Step: 9th Cuspal Sub Lord is either Mercury or Jupiter.
 Second Step: AND 9th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify negative
houses (9th house, 5th house and 8th house) and
 Third Step: AND 9th Cuspal Sub Lord should not signify positive
houses (10th house, 2nd house, 5th house, 9th house or 11th
house).
060 Rule for Good Astrologer / Good in Occult Science
 First Step: If 2nd Cuspal Sub Lord signifies either 9th house or
12th house, then the native will definitely be a good astrologer and
good in occult science too.

CINEMA / ACTING PROFESSION
061 Rule for acting profession
 First Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in the
constellation of a planet positioned in 5th house or 6th house or
11th house.
 Second Step: AND 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should have direct or
indirect connection with Venus.
062 Rule for Musical Profession/ Musical talents:
 First Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord is deposited in the constellation
of a planet positioned in 1st house.
 Second Step: AND the Ascendant of the native/querent must be
positioned in Leo Sign or Aquarius sign.A Compendium on KP Astrology
23

JOURNALISM PROFESSION
063 Rule for Journalism Profession:
 First Step: 3rd Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in
constellation of a planet which should signify 11th house.
 Second Step: AND 3rd Cuspal Sub Lord should be connected to
Mercury and Jupiter.

PRINTING PROFESSION /BUSINESS OF OWNING A
PRINTING UNIT
064 Rule for owning a printing unit
 First Step: 10th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 2nd house or 6th
house or 10th house.
 Second Step: AND Mercury should signify 2nd house or 6th house
or 10th house.
 Third Step: AND Jupiter should signify 2nd house or 6th house or
10th house.
 Fourth Step: AND Mars should signify 2nd house or 6th house or
10th house.

TEACHING PROFESSION
065 Rule for Teaching Profession:
 First Step: 10th Cuspal Sub Lord should be Mercury or any other
planet which is positioned in a dual sign.
 Second Step: AND Mercury should be well connected to 2nd house
which is the house of speech.
066 Rule for knowing Prosperity of an Institution:
 First Step: 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should not signify 6th house and
10th house.Basic Rules & Applied Horoscopes
24

rules.text:
Level of Wealth / Earn handsome money

If 2nd (Money) signifies 5 (12th from 6th Daily income) - 8 (Financial Loss, income of opponent) - 12 (Loss).

Some Wealth:
If 2nd (Money/Income) signifies 5 (12th from 6th Daily income) - 8 (Financial Loss, income of opponent) - 12 (Loss) along with 2 (Income) - 6 (Daily income) - 11 (Gain).

Enormous Wealth:
If 2nd (Income) signifies 2 (Income) - 6 (Daily income) - 10 (Profession/Status) - 11 (Gain) AND NOT CONNECTED to 5 (12th from 6th) - 8 (Financial Loss) - 12 (Loss).

rules.title: Longevity
rules.text:
Longevity: दीर्घायु

Rule 1:
If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant, be the significator of the house 6 or 8 or 12 the life is short (about 33 years).
If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant, be the significator of the house 1 or 5 or 9 or 10 the life is long (about more than 66 years).
If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant, be the significator of the house 6 or 8 or 12 and 1 or 5 or 9 or 10, the life is medium (about 66 years).
But if the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant, be the significator of the Badhaka and Maraka houses with the above mentioned houses, it is not good for life.
If the cuspal joint rulers (the sign lord, star lord and sub lord) of the Ascendant or the 8th cusp be the significator of the Badhaka and Maraka houses, their joint period is very critical for life.
In the short life term within 33 years, in the medium life term within 66 years and in the long life term above 66 years, also check the 3rd and 8th cusps too.
Badhaka bhava is more danger than Maraka bhava. So while checking about longevity, first check the Badhaka bhava and then Maraka bhava.

Rule 2:
If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant be the significator of the Badhaka and Maraka houses, the life term is short during their joint period and is very critical for life.

rules.title: Lost Article
rules.text:
Lost Article
If the cuspal sub lord of 2nd be the significator of 2 (movable article which is lost or stolen) - 6 (Article) - 11 (regaining), movable property will be regained during the joint period of the significator of 2-6-11.

rules.title: Love Affair & Marriage
rules.text:
Love Affair & Marriage
Love affair:
1) If 5th cusp sub lord signifies 11-2 (7), have a love partner/success in love affair (falls in love without sexual contact) during the joint period of 2-5-11.
2) If 5th cusp sublord signifies 5 & 12 or 5 & 8 or 11 & 8, having a love affair with sexual relations during period 5-8-12-11.
3) If 5th cusp sub lord signifies 5-8-12, scandalous love affair during joint period 5-8-12.
4) If 5th cusp sub lord signifies 5-6-8-12 (10), termination of love affair during joint period 5-6-8-12 (10).
5) If 5th cusp sub lord signifies 7 and 7th cusp sub lord signifies 5, then only love marriage is promised, during the joint period of 7-11-2-5.

Marriage:
If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th be the significator of 2 (Addition in family, Family life) - 7 (Marriage) - 11 (permanent relationship) marriage takes place during the joint period of 2-7-11.

Love marriage: If 5th cusp sub lord signifies 7 and 7th cusp sub lord signifies 5, then only love marriage is promised during 7-11-2-5.

Divorce/Separation:
If the sub lord of the 7th cusp be the significator of 1-6-10 (being 12th from 2-7-11), it does not promise marriage or denotes absence of married life.
If already married, during 1-6-10 joint period there may be no conjugal life or estrangement/separation; it also denotes divorce.

Reunion with spouse:
If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th be the significator of 2-7-5-11, reunion takes place during the joint period of 2-7-5-11.

Second Marriage:
If 7th cusp sub lord is Mercury or deposited in a dual sign (Gemini, Sagittarius, Pisces) or any planet occupying/deposited in star of dual sign or in the star of owner of dual sign (Mercury/Jupiter) and is a significator of 2-11, then during 2-11 there is a chance of second marriage.

 LOVE & MARRIAGE
GENERAL MARRIAGE RULES
001 Which Planets are relevant for love and marriage?
 Venus is the chief karaka of love and marriage. It also indicates love and sexual instinct of the native.
 Note: Sun is not good for married life as it indicates illegal relation with more than one partner when positioned in 7th house. The only exception is when Sun is placed in its own sign Leo.

002 Which Houses are considered for love and marriage?
The houses relevant for love and marriage are: -
 2nd House denotes family or kutumbha;
 3rd house indicates friendship and relationship;
 4th house denotes sexual pleasures between husband and wife in home;
 5th House denotes love marriage, love affairs, fulfillment of sexual pleasure and the quantum of success or failure achieved in love affairs;
 7th house denotes husband and contract of marriage in legal way;
 8th house denotes sexual enjoyment, dowry and parents·expenditure on wedding;
 9th house represents negotiation or contract for marriage as it is3rd from the 7th house;
 11th House indicates friendship, pleasure and strong ties, which may not be permanent;
 12th House indicates bed comforts and illegal affairs;
 In case where marriage is being solemnized to a foreigner, then 3rd, 9th or 12th house of the bride·s chart indicates travel to far-off place, preferably in a foreign country, for settling with groom's family; and
 6th or 10th house indicates break in love affairs.

003 Rule for Promise of Marriage:
 First Step:
x 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 2nd or 7th or 11th house.
x OR 7th Cuspal Sub Lord and 2nd, 5th or 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should be the same planet.
 Alternative Step: If the aforesaid rule is not satisfied, then 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 5th house or 8th house.

004 Rule for No Marriage at all/ Rule for denial of Marriage:
 First Step: If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies 6th, 12th and 10th House; without having any connection to 2nd, 3rd, 7th, 11th or 5th house,then the native will never get married.
 Alternative Step: If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord does not signify 2nd, 7th or 11th house at stellar level and sub level, then the native remain unmarried forever.
Note:
x Please remember that this situation will be very rare, hence one should be careful in making this prediction.
x If a planet is significator of 2nd, 7th or 11th house and it itself happens to be a single strong significator of 6th house (denoting separation), then that planet will not allow marriage in its Dasha or Bhukti.

005 Rule for Knowing Reasons for Marriage:
Note the 7th Cuspal Sub Lord and observe the house in which it is positioned.
 If it is positioned in 1st house, then personal concerns will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 2nd house, then financial security or family concerns will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 3rd house, then agreement or contract will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 4th house, then mother or property will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 5th house, then knowledge, love or colleagues will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 6th house, then health problems will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 7th house, then ex-partner or business deals will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 8th house, then debts or legal issues will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 9th house, then father, stranger, internet friends or higher education will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 10th house, then job or status in society will be the main reason for marriage;
 If it is positioned in 11th house, then colleagues or known friends will be the main reason for marriage; 
 If it is positioned in 12th house, then spiritual people, foreigners or unknown people will be the main reason for marriage.

006 Rule for Delay in Marriage/ Rule for Late Marriage/ Rule for failing of Marriage proposals:
 First Step:
x 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 2nd, 7th or 11th house and should be connected to 4th and 10th house also.
x Further, 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should not signify 3rd house.
 Alternative Step:
x If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord does not signify 2nd, 7th or 11th house at stellar signification, then sub level signification to 2nd, 7th or 11th house shall be studied.
x If the Sub Lord of 7th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies 2nd, 7th or 11th house, then the native will get married, but late in life.
 Note: Indication of Punarphoo Dosha, a condition of conjunction or aspect of Saturn and Moon in a horoscope, also indicates delay in marriage.

007 Rule for marriage with the same girl twice:
 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should be aspected by Lord of 8th house and there must be a Punarphoo Dosha in the houses under consideration for marriage.
 Note: This condition may arise in situation where the first marriage had occurred after running from home and then the couple subsequently got married again in front of the society after acceptance by both the families.

008 Rule for Grand Marriage:
 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 11th house along with 2nd and 7th house.

009 Rule for marrying rich bride or groom:
 First Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in the constellation of a planet which signifies 2nd, 7th and 11th house.
 Second Step: The significator of 2nd, 7th and 11th house in one horoscope should also be the Ruling Planets in another·s horoscope.

010 Rule for knowing the physical feature and characteristics of spouse
The physical feature and characteristics of spouse will depend upon 7th Cuspal Sub Lord and the Sign in which it is positioned. Hence the same is to be noted.
 If it is positioned in Aries, then the person will generally be of average height and possess lean and muscular body (neither stout nor thick). He/She may be of wheatish complexion with expressive eyes, long face and curly hair.
 If it is positioned in Taurus, then the person will generally be of medium stature with broad forehead, thick neck and bright eyes. He/she may have dark hair, fair complexion, broad shoulders,
well developed muscles and will be of cheering personality.
 If it is positioned in Gemini, then the person will generally be tall and upright coupled with moderate complexion (neither too fair nor too dark). He/She may have long hands, sharp eyes, long nose and charming personality.
 If it is positioned in Cancer, then the person will generally be of short stature with heavy body, slender limbs, powerful claws and prominent abdomen. The portion above abdomen will be more prominent than the lower parts. He/She may also walk with a rolling gait/pace.
 If it is positioned in Leo, then the person will generally be of moderate stature with a muscular body, well developed bones and broad forehead. He/She may have royal outlook, dignified personality and commanding appearance.
 If it is positioned in Virgo, then the person will generally have a tall and slender body. He/She may have shrill voice and curved eyebrows with bushy hair. He/She may often appear to be younger than his/her actual age. They will be very active and brisk walking people.
 If it is positioned in Libra, then the person will generally be of tall stature with well-proportioned body having slender but strong limbs and parrot like nose. He/She may be graceful and have humanitarian instincts with charming appearance and influential personality.
 If it is positioned in Scorpio, then the person will generally be of average stature with well-proportioned body having long hands and broad face. He/She may have commanding appearance with good and respectful personality.
 If it is positioned in Sagittarius, then the person will generally be of tall stature with well-developed muscles and broad forehead.He/She may have bushy eyebrows, long nose, graceful bright eyes, smiling face, fair complexion and handsome figure.
 If it is positioned in Capricorn, then the person will generally be emaciated, gaunt and weak. He/She may have long nose, deep set eyes, and coarse hair but the body growth will be slow.
 If it is positioned in Aquarius, then the person will generally be tall having fair complexion and handsome appearance.
 If it is positioned in Pisces, then the person will generally be short heighted having plumpy body, small hands and small feet.

011 Rule for checking about the partner:
7th Cuspal Sub Lord indicates the Spouse; hence the details of the spouse can be checked by churning the results of the following steps:
 First Step: Note the 7th Cuspal Sub Lord and observe the house where it is placed.
 Second Step: Further, note the house where constellation lord of 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is placed.

012 Rule for judging the age difference between partners:
Each planet indicates certain age difference:
x Saturn indicates much difference;
x Mars, Mercury and Moon indicate very little difference;
x Jupiter, Venus and Sun indicate proper difference; and
x Rahu and Kethu indicates the age of planet which is the lord of the zodiac sign in which it is positioned.
7th Cuspal Sub Lord indicates the age differences between partners, hence 7th Cuspal Sub Lord and Constellation Lord in which the 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is positioned is to be noted and predictions is to be made as follows:
x If both the planets are Saturn, then the age difference between partners will be more than 8-9 years.
x In case, if one planet is Saturn and the other planet is Moon, then the age difference between partners will be around 5-7 years.

013 Rule for checking who will survive whom:
 Rule from Husband’s Chart: If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is positioned in dual sign and it also happens to be a significator of Marakasthana and Badhakasthana house, then his wife will die earlier, i.e., he will survive longer than his wife.
 Rule from Wife’s Chart: If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is positioned in dual sign and it also happens to be a significator of Marakasthana and Badhakasthana houses, then her husband will die earlier, i.e., she will survive longer than her husband.

014 Rule to determine who will dominate Husband or Wife:
 Rule from Husband’s Chart: - If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is a significator of 7th, 8th, 12th and 5th house, then his wife will dominate over all the affairs of life.
 Rule from Wife Chart: - If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is a significator of 7th, 8th, 12th and 5th house, then her husband will dominate over all the affairs of the life.

rules.title: MARRIED LIFE
rules.text:
MARRIED LIFE
028 Rule for Happy Married Life/ Rule for harmonious married
Life/ Rule for checking good relation between spouses:
 First Step: 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 7th house or 11th
house.
 Alternative Step: 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 2nd, 5th, 7th
or 11th house, without signifying 6th house and/or 12th house.
 Alternative Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is either Venus or Jupiter
and should signify 2nd and 11th house.
029 Rule for Unhappy Married Life/ Rule for frequent quarrel or
displeasure in Married life:
 First Step: 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should strongly signify 6th house
(denoting deserting by the partner), 8th house (denoting
disharmony and quarrel) and 12th House (denoting native seeks
separation); without having signification to 7th or 11th house;
 Alternative Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 6th, 8th or 12th
house.
 Note: -
x Role of Mars: Mars in 8th house indicates quarrel and displeasure
between partners, except when Mars occupies its own sign.
x Role of Saturn: Saturn in 8th house indicates disturbed married
life and lack of warmness between the couple. It may also be on
account of denial of sexual intercourse.
INTER-CASTE / UNCONVENTIONAL MARRIAGE
030 Rule for inter caste marriage:
 First Step: 7th Cusp Co-rulers (i.e., Sign Lord, Constellation Lord
and Sub Lord) should be connected to either Mars or Saturn or
Rahu.
 Alternative Step: If 7th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies 5th house and
11th house, then it denotes love marriage. Further, if it is also
connected to Rahu or Kethu, then it indicates an inter-caste
marriage or unconventional marriage.A Compendium on KP Astrology
13
LIVE-IN RELATIONSHIP
031 Rule for going for live-in relationship:
 First Step: 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should not be in retrograde
motion.
 Second Step: 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should not be deposited in
constellation of a planet which is retrograde in motion.
 Third Step: 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 2nd, 5th, 7th and
11th house.
032 Rule for checking who will start the live-in relationship:
 Rule for native/querent: If 11th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies 3rd
house, then the querent will take the initiative for staring the
relationship.
 Rule for person other than querent: If 11th Cuspal Sub Lord
signifies 9th house, then the other person will take the initiative
for starting the relationship.
 Timing of Event: The conjoined period of significators of 2nd, 5th,
7th and 11th house will be taken into consideration for
fructification of the event which should agree with the ruling
planets at the date, place and time of judgement.
LOVE AFFAIRS
033 Rule for love marriage/ Rule for materialization of love
affair into marriage
 First Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 5th house and either
2nd or 7th or 11th house. Further 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should also
signify 2nd, 7th or 11th house.
 Alternative Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord and 7th Cuspal Sub Lord
should be the same planet.
 Alternative Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should directly/indirectly be
connected to 5th house and 7th house.
 Alternative Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be strong significator
of 7th house and 11th house.Basic Rules & Applied Horoscopes
14
034 Rule for judging whether the love affair is one side or both
sided:
 11th Cuspal Sub Lord and 5th Cuspal Sub Lord are to be studied
for judging whether love affair is both sided or one sided.
In case the query is asked by the girl querent, then, if 5th Cuspal
Sub Lord signifies 11th house, it is predicted that the girl loves
the boy.
035 Rule for checking whether boy loves the girl:
 For knowing this, the horary chart must be rotated to 11th
house, so that the 11th house can be treated as the ascendant
of the boy.
Now in this rotated chart, if 3rd Cuspal Sub Lord (i.e., 5th from 11th
house) signifies 1st house, then it is predicted that the boy loves the
girl.
036 Rule for Time pass love/ Rule for Casual Love affair
 First Step: If 5th Cuspal Sub Lord is directly /indirectly connected
to 6th house and 12th house along with the signification of 2nd, 5th,
7th and 11th house, then it will be a time pass love affair.
 Alternative Step: If 5th Cuspal Sub Lord signifies both positive
houses (2nd, 5th, 7th and 11th house) as well as negative houses (6th
and 12th house), then it will be a casual love affair.
037 Rule for Failure /Non-Materialization of Love affair into
marriage:
 First Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in
constellation of a planet which signifies 6th house and/or 12th
house.
 Alternative Step: OR 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in
the constellation of a planet which signifies 4th house and 10th
house.
038 Rule for judging who will drop from the idea of love
marriage:
 Rule for dropping of idea by the Querent: If 5th Cuspal Sub Lord is
deposited in constellation of a planet which signifies 12th house,
then the querent will drop the idea of love marriage.
 Rule for dropping of idea by the Lover: If 5th Cuspal Sub Lord is
deposited in constellation of a planet which signifies 6th house,
then the querent·s lover will withdraw from the idea of love
marriage.A Compendium on KP Astrology
15
039 Rule for Sexual Pleasure with Companion without getting
married:
 First Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 5th House and 8th
House (obstacles and opposition); without signifying 2nd, 7th or
11th house.
 Second Step: 5th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 5th, 4th and 8th
house; without signifying 2nd, 7th or 11th house.

rules.text:
Missing Person / Pet
Missing person:
If the cuspal sublord of 11th be the significator of 2-8-11, a person returns home during the joint period of 2-8-11.

Missing Pet:
If the cuspal sublord of 11th be the significator of 2, 8 or 11, a pet returns home during the joint period of 2, 8 and 11. (Also check 4th Sub Lord as 6th is pet and 11th from 6th is 4th.)

rules.title: MULTIPLE MARRIAGES
rules.text:
MULTIPLE MARRIAGES
027 Rule for Multiple Marriages:
 First Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 9th house along with
either 2nd or 7th or 11th house.
 Second Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should be Mercury or Jupiter
OR if 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is a planet other that Mercury or
Jupiter, then it should be placed in a dual sign (Gemini, Virgo,
Sagittarius or Pisces) OR 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited
in the constellation of a planet which is in dual sign (Gemini,
Virgo, Sagittarius or Pisces).
 Third Step: 2nd Cuspal Sub Lord should signify either7th house or
11th house.
 Timing of Event: The timing for fructification of event shall be
determined by considering the planet signification of 2nd house,
7th house, 9th house and 11th house as agreeing with the ruling
planets at the time and place of judgement.
 Note: Jupiter indicates two marriages whereas Mercury indicates
multiple marriages.

rules.text:
Negotiation Success
If the sub-lord of the 3rd cusp be the significator of the houses 6 and 11, then one will have success. But if it be significator of the houses 5 and 12, one cannot have success.
The houses which are to be considered for judgment depend on query: marriage (7th, 3, 9); business/job (10th, 6, 3, 9); adoption (5th, 3, 9).

rules.title: New Business ／ Project
rules.text:
New Business / Project
If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant or 11th be the significator of 1-2-3-6-10-11, then success in effort/planning in project is promised.

rules.title: Partnership & Breakup
rules.text:
Partnership & Breakup
If the sub lord of the 8th cusp (partner’s money) be the significator of 6-11, the native gets a partner.
If the sub lord of the 8th cusp (partner’s money) be the significator of 5-12, the native will not get a partner.
If the sub lord of the 7th cusp (partnership) be the significator of 5-11, the partnership continues for a long time.
If the sub lord of the 7th cusp be the significator of 8-12, the partnership will break.
If 7th cusp sub lord be the significator of 6th, partner will break; if significator of 12th, querent will break partnership during joint period of 6-12.
If owner of 7th and occupant of 7th be a significator of 11th, querent gets benefit from partnership. But if they be a significator of 7-12, it is loss in partnership.

rules.title: Planning for Expanding Business
rules.text:
Planning for Expanding Business
If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant or cuspal sub lord of 11th be the significator of the 1-2-3-6-10-11, then planning/success in effort/success in project is promised.

rules.title: Professional Examination
rules.text:
Professional Examination
For competitive/professional examinations consider 4-6-9-11.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 4-6-9-11, success is promised during the joint period of 4-6-9-11.

rules.title: Redevelopment of House
rules.text:
Redevelopment of House
If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th (renovate building) be the significator of 4 (land/building) - 7 (renovate building) - 11 (success/fulfillment of desire) one will be able to renovate house during the joint period of 7-4-11.

rules.title: Relation with Friend
rules.text:
Relation with Friend
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 1-5-11, relation with friend will be good during the joint period of 1-5-11.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 6-8-12, relation with friend will be not good during the joint period of 6-8-12.

rules.title: Relations with Others
rules.text:
Relations with Others
If the cuspal sub lord of the 10th be the significator of 7-8-12, person faces lot of trouble from relatives or opponents during the joint period of 7-8-12.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 10th be the significator of 1-5-11, one gets relief during the joint period of 1-5-11.

rules.title: Retirement
rules.text:
Retirement in Job
For job/business we check 2-6-10. 12th from these (1-5-9) are negative for 2-6-10. Thus for retirement consider 1-5-9-12.
If sub lord of 10th or 6th be the significator of 1-5-9-12, the querent can retire from service during the joint period of 1-5-9-12. (Generally connected with 2-6-10 service houses.)

rules.title: Return to Homeland
rules.text:
Return to Homeland / Motherland
If the 11th cuspal sublord signifies 2-8-11, during the joint period of 2-8-11 one can come back to homeland.
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 2, 8 and 11, return to home is promised during the joint period of the significators of 2, 8 and 11.

rules.title: Reunion with Spouse
rules.text:
Reunion with Spouse
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11th be the significator of 2-7-11, reunion with spouse is promised during the joint period of 2-7-11.

rules.title: Rule for doing Business Profess
rules.text:
doing Business /Profession:
 First Step:
x 10th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 7th house.
x OR 10th Cuspal Sub Lord should be connected to 7th and 10th
house.
 Second Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify either 2nd ,6th or
10th house.
 Timing of Event: The timing of starting new business/ profession
will be during the conjoined period of Joint significators of 2nd, 7th
and 10th house.
049 Rule for being Trader/ Business Person:
For becoming a trader or businessman, 10th Cuspal Sub Lord should
signify 7th and 2nd house.
050 Rule for judging whether one will start a business:
 First Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should be deposited in the
constellation of a planet which should be in direct motion.
 Second Step: 7th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify 11th and 1st
house.
 Timing of Event: The timing of starting business will be determined
during the conjoined period of joint significators of 7th, 11th and
1st house.

rules.title: Selling Property
rules.text:
Selling Property (House/Land)
If the cuspal sub lord of the 10th house (land/building of opponent, 4th from 7th) be the significator of 3 (absence of land/building, 12th from 4th) - 5 (success/fulfillment of desire of opponent, 11th from 7th) - 10 (land/building of opponent, 4th from 7th), selling is promised during the joint period of 3-5-10.

rules.title: Rumour – True or False
rules.text:
Rumour – True or False
If the cuspal sub lord of 3rd happens to be Saturn, the rumour is false. If it is Mars, it is mischievous. If it is Jupiter, it is true.
If the lord is connected with Saturn in any manner the report is false; if connected with Jupiter, the report will be correct.

rules.title: SEXUAL PLEASURE
rules.text:
SEXUAL PLEASURE
019 Rule for judging sexual pleasure with Spouse/ Married
partners:
7th Cuspal Sub Lord will help in knowing the degree of sexual pleasure
between the partners.
 First Step: Note 7th Cuspal Sub Lord and its sexual traits as per
the detailed description mentioned in Note below.
 Second Step: Further, note the sexual traits of the constellation
lord in which the 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is positioned as per the
detailed description mentioned in Note below.
 Third Step: Predict the results after churning the sexual traits of
the planets obtained in the first Step and Second Step. For
example:
x If both the planets are Venus, then the person will be highly
sexed and would prefer doing sexual intercourse on regular
basis.
x If one planet is Venus and the other is Mars, then the person
will love having sexual intercourse in aggressive mood.
Note: Every Planet has unique traits with respect to their sexual
behaviour. These are listed below for understanding and reference of
the readers:
x Saturn indicates dissatisfaction after intercourse or denial of sex
with the partner.
x Mars indicates silly quarrel during sex or aggressive sex or male
forces female for sex or displeasure exceeds pleasure after sex.
x Mercury indicates talking while having sex or having sex more
than once.
x Moon indicates very pleasant sex like honeymoon.
x Jupiter indicates normal, pleasant and dutiful sex. Normally,
such people avoid having sex on religious days or tithis.
x Venus indicates sixty-four leela sex, i.e., extreme pleasure.
x Sun indicates repulsion during sex or no pleasure from sex.
x Rahu and Kethu indicate the results of the planets which is the
Lord of the zodiac sign in which they are positioned.

rules.title: Success in Deal
rules.text:
Success in Deal
If the sub lord of the Ascendant (Deal/Transaction) cusp be the significator of 3-9-11 then native succeeds in dealing, during the joint period of 3-9-11.

rules.title: Success in Politics
rules.text:
Success in Politics / Position in Politics
If the cuspal sub lord of the 10th (one’s position in politics) be the significator of 3 (one’s ability) - 10 (one’s Reputation) - 11 (one’s reputation as a winner), then during the joint period of 3-10-11, winning in election or getting higher position in politics is assured.

rules.title: Treasure in House
rules.text:
Treasure in House
If the sub lord of the 4th cusp be the significator of the houses 2-11-6 and connected with Saturn, one will surely have the treasure in house during joint period of 2-6-11.
If the sub-lord of the 11th cusp be the significator of the houses 4-11, one will surely have the treasure in house during joint period of 4-8-11.

rules.title: War – Timing & Outcome
rules.text:
War – Timing & Outcome
Is there any war? When?
If 3rd (relations with neighbouring country) sub lord be the significator of 4th (concern of national security), 9th (foreign relation), 7th (International disputes), there will be a war during joint period of 4-9-7.

Who will win?
If 10th (national reputation) sub lord be the significator of 4 (outcome of anything) - 10 (national reputation, the end of war) - 2 (enemy’s death), one will win in war during joint period of 4-10-2.

rules.title: Winning in Court Case
rules.text:
Winning in Court Case
If the cuspal sub lord of the 4th (Result of Lawsuit) be the significator of 2 (Winning) - 10 (Success) - 11 (Gain), one will be able to win lawsuit during the joint period of 2-10-11.

rules.title: Terrorist Attack
rules.text:
Terrorist Attack (Where?)
If 12th (Secret Organizations) signifies 2 (Maraka) - 7 (Maraka) - 8 (Violent Death/Disaster) - Badhaka, then there is a chance of terror attack, during the joint period of 8 - Maraka - Badhaka.
Where? Places signified by 8th (terrorist) sublord can be the target e.g.,
3 = Post office, Telephone Office, Train, Junior School, Library, News Room.
4 = Department store / shopping mall, place near water.
5 = Amusement park, cinema theatre, stock exchange.
6 = Clinic.
9 = Ashram, temple, college — religious places.
10 = Private club, office space, terminal.
